```{r load-library}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(ez)

```
#get the data

```{r load-data}
# read a data file that is text with columns separated by spaces and strings as factors
results <- read.table("data/Results.txt", header = TRUE, sep = " ", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
```
## Look at the number of measures by GROUP and ID

We want a table that shows the number of measures for each combination og GROUP and ID

```{r count-measures-by-group-id}
results %>%
  count(GROUP, ID )
```
We suppress ID3 and count again

```{r}
results %>%
  filter(ID !="ID3") %>%
  count(GROUP, ID ) 
```
We now check the REP factor

```{r check-REP}
results %>%
  filter(ID !="ID3") %>%
  count(REP)

results %>%
  filter(ID != "ID3") %>%
  count(GROUP, REP)
```
We now suppress REP3 because of missing data and count again

```{r}
results %>%
  filter(ID != "ID3") %>%
  filter(REP != "R3") %>%
  count(GROUP, ID, REP)  
```

```{r}
# count the number of participants in each group after suppressing ID3 and REP3
results %>%
  filter(ID != "ID3") %>%
  filter(REP != "R3") %>%
  count(GROUP) 
```
```{r}
# count how many different SUBJ by GROUP
results %>%
  filter(ID != "ID3") %>%
  filter(REP != "R3") %>%
  group_by(GROUP) %>%
  summarise(n_subj = n_distinct(SUBJ))
```
